Vacancy for Research Scientist
Saturday, 19 March 2022
3404 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) invites applications for the post of
Research Scientist I
(one post) in the Centre for Genetics and Genomics at MGIMS in the prescribed proforma (available on website: www.mgims.ac.in) . Enclose all certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates with your application which should reach to the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha – 442102, Maharashtra (email: secretaryoffice@ mgims.ac.in) latest by 31/03/2022.
Eligibility:
Postgraduate qualification in life sciences in Genetics/ Biotechnology and allied disciplines/Molecular Biology/Human Genetics/Immunology from an Indian University/Institute or a foreign University/Institute recognized by UGC.
Desirable:
a) Preference will be given to those possessing 3-year diagnostic experience with Ph. D in the areas of Human Genetics/Medical Genetics/Biotechnology/ Human Genetics Disease Diagnosis etc. and also the publications.
b) Research experience in Cytogenetic and molecular cytogenetic including Chromosome Analysis using techniques like Fluorescence in situ Hybridization (FISH), and knowledge of techniques such as PCR, Fluorescence Microscopy and quality Publications in the related field in index journals as first/corresponding author.
Click here to download the form
Salary:
As per the rules of Kasturba Health Society.
Age:
Upper age limit 40 years for open category and 45 years for reserved category.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
